content.title: Chapter 38 - ENVIRONMENT — Sec. 38-405. - Penalty.
content.summary:
The keeping or maintaining of bees in violation of any provision of this article shall
               be punishable by a fine or imprisonment, or both, not to exceed the limits established
               in
section 1-5
of this Code.
(
Ord. No. 4345, § 1, 8-6-2012
)
